annotation.title_clean: ISO/WD 26058-1 Safety requirements for industrial mobile robots — Part 1: Industrial mobile robots
annotation.title_en: ISO/WD 26058-1 Safety requirements for industrial mobile robots — Part 1: Industrial mobile robots
annotation.summary_en: ISO store page for the working draft ISO/WD 26058-1, a Type C safety standard for ground-travelling industrial mobile robots in industrial environments. It sets scope and exclusions (industrial trucks, exoskeletons, road vehicles, cleaning robots, non-industrial use) and shows lifecycle stage 20.60 as of December 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Type C safety standard for ground-travelling industrial mobile robots in restricted-access industrial environments
Part 1 of a series; Part 2 will cover integration of applications
Excludes industrial trucks (ISO 3691-4), actively stabilised robots (ISO/NP 25785-1), exoskeletons, road vehicles, agricultural and floor-cleaning machines
Excludes hazards such as explosive or nuclear environments, ionizing radiation and person transport
Developed by ISO/TC 299; at stage 20.60 (comment period closed 2025-12-18)
